findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Quotient.lean:316 `lemma natTransLift_app ... (natTransLift r τ).app ((Quotient.functor r).obj X) = τ.app X := rfl`
findings.fix: Replace the `change` with `rw [CategoryTheory.Quotient.natTransLift_app, CategoryTheory.Quotient.natTransLift_app]` (or `simp only [Quotient.natTransLift_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app]`), then continue with `quotientFunctor_map_eq_iff`.
findings.issue: The `change` in the compatibility proof of `map₂` relies on `natTransLift` components unfolding by definition; the comment says what the goal becomes, not why a rewrite can't reach it.

findings.evidence: `map₂_map_app` (same file): `((map₂ ...).map (I₁.quotientFunctor.map f)).app (I₂.quotientFunctor.obj X₂) = J.quotientFunctor.map ((F.map f).app X₂)`
findings.fix: Replace the `change` and the `rw` before it with `simp only [NatTrans.app_add, map₂_map_app, Functor.map_add, NatTrans.app_add]`, or `rw [map₂_map_app]` followed by `Functor.map_add`.
findings.issue: The `Additive` instance for `map₂` uses `change` for the same component unfolding, although the PR proves `map₂_map_app` for exactly this.
The `Linear` instance for `map₂` repeats the same `change` unfolding (same defect as line 158).

findings.fix: Close it with `simp only [Functor.flip_obj_map, Functor.map_smul, NatTrans.app_smul]`, matching the `Additive` flip instance.
findings.issue: The `Linear` instance for the flipped functor ends with an uncommented `rfl` that relies on definitional unfolding; the `Additive` version of the same instance closes the goal with `simp only`.

findings.evidence: lines 165 and 179: `rw [show Z₁ = I₁.quotientFunctor.obj Z₁.as from rfl, map₂_obj_quotientFunctor_obj]`
findings.fix: Destructure the object (`obtain ⟨X₁⟩ := Z₁`, or `cases Z₁`), then `rw [map₂_obj_quotientFunctor_obj]` at both sites.
findings.issue: `rw [show Z₁ = I₁.quotientFunctor.obj Z₁.as from rfl, ...]` relies on how `Quotient` objects are built; the same pattern appears at line 179.

summary: Several proofs in `MorphismIdeal/Bifunctor.lean` use `change` or a bare `rfl` to unfold `Quotient.natTransLift`/`Quotient.lift` components, even though explicit lemmas for those steps already exist (`Quotient.natTransLift_app`, and the PR's own `map₂_map_app`). Replace the definitional-equality steps with rewrites.
